newsitem.title: USA: Montgomery Ward stops paying some vendors - report.
newsitem.headline: Montgomery Ward stops paying some vendors - report.

text.p: Montgomery Ward Holding Corp has stopped paying many of its vendors, the New York Times reported Wednesday, quoting "people familiar with the situation."
The newspaper also said merchandise financing companies had told some suppliers not to make shipments to the Chicago-based discount retailer.
Montgomery Ward officials were not available for comment on the report.
The report follows news that Montgomery Ward is cutting 400 corporate jobs and is in talks to sell its Signature Group direct-marketing division.
